metrics.label: Profit after tax attributable to owners

change: Tech Mahindra brought in more revenue. The cost of delivering its services rose more slowly, helping profit increase faster than revenue.
watch: Watch whether new contracts turn into billed work and whether the cost of doing that work stays in check.
